answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the oasis queue naming the dune that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 4 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every sock puppet costs 4 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the beacon record makes public exactly who is still on probation. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
